title: Oppenheimer and Snyder on continued gravitational collapse
summary: Their 1939 paper is a classic general-relativistic collapse calculation.
body: J. R. Oppenheimer and H. Snyder, "On Continued Gravitational Contraction" (Physical Review, 1939), analyzed the collapse of a star in general relativity. It is a theoretical paper on the road to the black-hole concept. It is not an observation of a stellar collapse, and it does not fix the v1 threshold of "more than 20 solar masses," which is left unsourced.
